scope: Visible, localizable ball moments from the same panoramic recording. Positive-only subset; no claim over occluded/ambiguous moments or other cameras. Training/validation/test groups inherited from selection made before inference. Extra training frames at +0.2s stay within the same training groups. Test selection uses source visibility, never detector output.
exclusion_reason: Ball not confidently localized during source inspection; not treated as negative.
